status: development build authorized for owner wrist trial; not a release candidate and not owner pixel approved
purpose: Bind the exact already-built development APK to the source and studio commits that produced it. Evidence only: nothing was rebuilt, redesigned or re-signed to produce this record.

reproducibility.method: rm -rf app/build build .gradle, then tools/build_face.sh attitude-meridian; the resulting APK SHA-256 equalled the first build's
reproducibility.note: Observed during the build cycle that produced this artifact. This record did NOT rebuild to re-confirm it; the instruction was explicit that the exact existing APK must not be rebuilt or replaced.

generation_drift.aurelius: OK — committed XML matches deterministic generation
generation_drift.attitude-meridian: OK — committed XML matches deterministic generation

aod_metrics.method: ITU-R BT.601 luma, Y = 0.299*R + 0.587*G + 0.114*B on the 8-bit sRGB values as stored; a pixel is bright when Y > 40 (strictly greater). Identical definition to scripts/attitude_aod_metrics.py, so the numbers are comparable to the Phase 1 concepts.

consumer_render.rendered_from: the committed watchface.xml and the drawables that go into the APK

aod_metrics.consumer_studio_difference_note: The two differ by 0.037 percentage points because the studio render draws the readouts with a system TTF while the consumer render composes the shipped bitmap-font glyphs. Both are reported; neither is a substitute for the other.
aod_metrics.wo_p7_statement: This is a development measurement of a 480x480 render, not a WO-P7 certification and not a measurement of the physical Watch7 panel.

motion.isolation: the contract lives only in the z00_horizon component of engine/face.toml; changing it requires no artwork, layout or resource change

device.delivery: file supplied to the owner for phone-mediated manual installation
